id.description: Identifier of the content item to read.

type.description: A public content type this site registers, for example post or page. Defaults to post.

status.description: Return only items in this status. Defaults to every status except trash.

search.description: Return only items matching this search term.

parent.description: Return only children of this content item; 0 returns top-level items.

offset.description: Items to skip before the page begins.

type.description: A public content type this site registers, for example post or page.

limit.description: Terms returned per taxonomy, clamped to 100.

offset.description: Terms to skip within each taxonomy before the page begins.

unreadableTaxonomies.description: Names of taxonomies whose terms could not be read, matching taxonomies[].name. Their terms and termTotal are not trustworthy. Absent when every taxonomy was read successfully.

id.description: Identifier of the content item to read.

path.description: Address of one block, as dot-separated sibling indexes such as "2" or "2.0.1". Omit for the whole outline.

redirects.description: Every stored redirect, ordered by source path.

source.description: The canonical path on this site that is redirected.

target.description: Where the visitor is sent, or null when the status is 410 and there is no successor.

status.description: The HTTP status this redirect answers with.

forwardQuery.description: Whether the visitor's query string is carried over to the target.

capacity.description: The greatest number of redirects this site will store.

id.description: Identifier of the content item whose links to check.

brokenOnly.description: Return only the links that resolve to nothing. Counts still describe every link found.

postId.description: Return only comments on this content item.

status.description: Return only comments in this status. Defaults to approved and pending together; spam and trash are returned only when asked for by name.

search.description: Return only comments matching this search term in their author, email, site, or body.

limit.description: Page size, clamped to 100. Defaults to 20.

offset.description: Comments to skip before the page begins.

path.description: Address of the block to change, as dot-separated sibling indexes such as "2" or "2.0.1".

name.description: The block name expected at that address, such as "core/paragraph". The request is refused if a different block is there.

attributes.description: Attributes to set, merged into the block's existing attributes.

removeAttributes.description: Attribute names to remove from the block.

innerHtml.description: Replacement inner markup. Permitted only on a block with exactly one chunk of markup and no inner blocks.

plan.description: The change plan to approve, including its plan token.

target.description: The concrete target that was written.

changed.description: The fields the approved plan changed.

state.description: The verified persisted state of the target.

source.description: The path on this site to redirect, such as /old-pricing. A query string is ignored, a trailing slash does not matter, and the site's home page cannot be a source.

target.description: Where to send the visitor: a path on this site, or an absolute http or https URL on any host. A target may carry its own query string, which wins over the visitor's where the two name the same argument. Send null when the status is 410 and the page has no successor.

status.description: The HTTP status to answer with. 301 and 308 are permanent and pass ranking signals on; 302 and 307 are temporary and do not; 410 says the page is gone and takes no target.

forwardQuery.description: Whether to carry the visitor's query string over to the target. Defaults to true, so campaign and analytics arguments survive the redirect.

changed.description: The fields the approved plan changed.

changed.description: The fields the approved plan changed.

tagline.description: The site tagline. An empty string clears it.

timezone.description: A PHP timezone identifier such as Europe/London or UTC.

dateFormat.description: The PHP date format string, e.g. "F j, Y".

timeFormat.description: The PHP time format string, e.g. "g:i a".

postsPerPage.description: How many posts blog pages show, 1 to 100.

showOnFront.description: Whether the front page shows latest posts or a static page. Choosing "page" requires a front page.

frontPageId.description: The published page shown as the static front page, or 0 to unset it.

postsPageId.description: The published page that lists posts when the front page is static, or 0 to unset it.

permalinkStructure.description: The permalink structure, e.g. "/%postname%/". Must contain %postname% or %post_id%; an empty string selects plain permalinks. Changing it changes every public URL.

defaultCommentStatus.description: Whether NEW posts allow comments by default. Existing posts are not changed.

defaultPingStatus.description: Whether NEW posts accept pingbacks and trackbacks by default.

searchEngineVisibility.description: false asks search engines not to index the site. This is the setting that deindexes a site; the preview warns when turning it off.

role.description: Return only users holding this role slug. Roles are registered by the site, so call this operation without a role first to see which slugs exist.

search.description: Return only users matching this term in their login, email, display name, or site URL.

limit.description: Page size, clamped to 100. Defaults to 20.

correlationId.description: Return only events for this request correlation identifier.

actorId.description: Return only events performed by this WordPress user.

since.description: Return only events recorded at or after this UTC instant.

until.description: Return only events recorded at or before this UTC instant.
